description: Use this to permanently delete stored data. scope sender deletes every evaluation and the scoreboard row for one sender_domain, which is then required (for example "stripe.com"). scope desk deletes the whole desk: criteria, senders and evaluations. Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone, so confirm the scope with the user before calling. Returns purged true and what was deleted. Errors: scope sender with no sender_domain is refused with invalid_input; send sender_domain or use scope desk. Not for changing criteria; use set_criteria.

scope.description: What to delete: "sender" for one sender's records, or "desk" for the whole desk. Confirm with the user first.

sender_domain.description: Required when scope is "sender": the sender domain to delete, such as "stripe.com". Ignored for scope desk.

name: purge_data

as_of.description: Day of the call, as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

message.description: Plain statement of what was deleted.

purged.description: True when the records were deleted.

source.description: Where the data comes from: the user's own private desk.

title: Purge Desk Data
